summary: Nav coverage is strong (16 of 19 prototype pages are listed, correctly gated on real backing) but content coverage is almost nil: 15 of those 17 visible pages -- everything except Appearance and About -- render only the generic 'backed but not built' placeholder, so none of the prototype's actual Backends/Providers/Models/Agents/Policies/Doctor/etc. UI exists in the app. The two built pages (Appearance, About) are themselves incomplete versus the prototype. The nav also drops the prototype's CONNECTION/AGENTS/TELEMETRY/APP section headers (flat list instead of grouped), and hides Relays/Plugins/Data & backups -- the last two despite real, working client-side code (wire/plugins.ts, wire/settings-export.ts) sitting completely unwired to any UI.

Screenshot: apps/web/screenshots/conformance-audit/app-settings-open.png shows plain lowercase 'settings', no gear glyph.
